_comment: Copy to shack_manifest.json. This file describes YOUR world: the recurring character, the sets, and the reference library. The Scene Builder and the Discord bot build their prompts from it. Mark an asset discord_ok only if community members may render it.

character.name: your on-screen persona
character.look: e.g. man in a navy cap and gray robe, salt-and-pepper beard

sets.name: MY WORKSHOP
sets.desc: describe lighting, furniture, camera angles — the more concrete, the steadier the renders

sets.name: MY BACKYARD
sets.desc: same here: what a camera sees when it walks in

assets.desc: the character, front view, neutral backdrop — the identity master
wide master of the main set, no character in frame
private reference — no discord_ok means Discord members cannot use it
